description: New controllers: BookGroupController (with CURD<BookGroup> implementation + saveBookGroupOrder), FileController (file management with list/upload/download/mkdir/delete/importPreview/restore/parse), HttpTTSController (with CURD<HttpTTS>). Enhanced BookController with new methods (saveBookGroupId, addBookGroupMulti, removeBookGroupMulti, getBookShelfBooks, getShelfBookWithCacheInfo, searchBookMulti, searchBookMultiSSE, searchBookSource, searchBookSourceSSE, searchBookWithSource, importBookPreview, refreshLocalBook, exportBook, exportToEpub, exportToTxt, getAllContents, getBookCover, cacheBookOnServer, cacheBookSSE, bookSourceDebugSSE, backupToMongodb, restoreFromMongodb, saveBookInfoCache, mergeBookCacheInfo, getBookSourceStringBySourceURLOpt, syncBookProgressFromWebdav, saveBookProgressToWebdav, syncFromWebdav, saveToWebdav, createUserBackup, getLastBackFileFromWebdav, getLocalChapterList enhanced). Enhanced UserController with new methods (addUser, resetPassword, clearInactiveUsers, updateUser, getUserInfo, saveUserConfig, getUserConfig, uploadFile, deleteFile, downloadBackupFile, forEachUser). Enhanced WebdavController (webdavMove, webdavCopy, webdavLock, webdavUnLock already exist in dev, just ensure backupToWebdav is complete). Enhanced YueduApi with new scheduled methods and contextPath support.
steps: Step 1: Create src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/BookGroupController.kt - class BookGroupController(coroutineContext) extends BaseController implements CURD<BookGroup>. Implement all CURD methods using JSONTable<BookGroup> with tableName 'bookGroup'. Add saveBookGroupOrder(context: RoutingContext): ReturnData method that accepts a list of group IDs and reorders them.

Step 2: Create src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/FileController.kt - class FileController(coroutineContext) extends BaseController. Methods: list(context) - list files in user's storage or specified path; upload(context) - handle file upload; download(context) - send file for download; get(context) - get file content; save(context) - save content to file; mkdir(context) - create directory; delete(context)/deleteMulti(context) - delete files; importPreview(context) - preview files for import; restore(context) - restore from backup file; parse(context) - parse file content; checkAccess(context) - verify user has file access permission.

Step 3: Create src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/HttpTTSController.kt - class HttpTTSController(coroutineContext) extends BaseController implements CURD<HttpTTS>. Implement all CURD methods using JSONTable<HttpTTS> with tableName 'httpTTS'.

Step 4: Enhance BookController.kt - Add the many new methods that exist in the JAR but not in dev. The dev already has many of these routes registered in YueduApi.kt (searchBookMulti, searchBookMultiSSE, bookSourceDebugSSE, cacheBookSSE, getShelfBookWithCacheInfo, exportBook, importBookPreview, refreshLocalBook, saveBookGroupId, addBookGroupMulti, removeBookGroupMulti, searchBookSource, searchBookSourceSSE, searchBookContent, getBookCover). Ensure all method implementations are complete. Add missing methods: backupToMongodb, restoreFromMongodb, convertPdfToImage, convertPdfPageToImage, savePdfPageToImage, exportToEpub, exportToTxt, getAllContents, cacheBookOnServer, searchBookWithSource, saveBookInfoCache, mergeBookCacheInfo, getBookSourceStringBySourceURLOpt, createUserBackup. The existing stub methods in the dev that reference non-existent functionality should be filled in.

Step 5: Enhance UserController.kt - The dev already has routes for addUser, resetPassword, updateUser, getUserInfo, saveUserConfig, getUserConfig, uploadFile, deleteFile. Ensure these method implementations properly handle the new User fields (enable_book_source, enable_rss_source, book_source_limit, book_limit). Add forEachUser utility method. Ensure formatUser in BaseController includes new User fields in its output.
Step 6: Update BaseController.kt - Add formatUser output for new User fields. Ensure the checkAuth and related methods work with the enhanced User entity fields.

Step 7: Update YueduApi.kt - Register routes for new controllers (BookGroupController, FileController, HttpTTSController). Add contextPath support (prefix all routes with configurable contextPath). Add new scheduled methods: remoteBookSourceSubUpdateJob (periodic remote book source update), autoBackup (auto backup user data if enabled), autoGC (periodic garbage collection). Update shelfUpdateJob to use configurable interval. Add the migration() enhancement for workDir support.

Step 8: Create src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/LicenseController.kt - class LicenseController(coroutineContext) extends BaseController. Methods for license management: getLicense, importLicense, generateKeys, generateLicense, isHostValid, decryptLicense, activateLicense, isLicenseValid, checkLicense, sendCodeToEmail, supplyLicense. The license system should be functional but optional (works without a license by default - all features available).
acceptance_criteria: Project compiles successfully with ./gradlew -b cli.gradle assemble
FileController methods handle file operations safely (path traversal prevention)
All new routes registered in YueduApi.kt
LicenseController compiles and is registered but app works without active license
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/reader-dev && ./gradlew -b cli.gradle clean assemble --info 2>&1 | tail -20
findings: Build verified successfully with ./gradlew -b cli.gradle clean assemble. All new controllers compile and routes are registered. contextPath support uses Vert.x reroute mechanism. The File.unzip extension function from Ext.kt requires calling it as file.unzip(path) not unzip(file, path). BookSourceController.updateRemoteSourceSub was added as a new method since it did not previously exist. The scheduled jobs use Spring @Scheduled annotations matching the existing pattern.
